method: Manual review of a fixed 3-second frame for every story/seed/variant, backed by the 45 source MP4 files. Pass requires the requested attribute and preservation of the original ad subject/story context.

color_red_to_blue.note: All three stories and all seeds retain the coupe and setting while changing red to blue.

coupe_to_suv.note: All outputs become SUVs and retain the broad story/setting; fine vehicle identity and original red color are not preserved.

coast_to_snow.note: The edit collapses to unrelated women/anime/singer imagery; neither snow-road target nor vehicle/story is preserved.

male_to_female.note: Women appear consistently, but the vehicle and ad action disappear, so this is not an independent person-slot edit.

overall: Vector editing is repeatable for color and coarse vehicle class, but not universal or slot-independent for scene/person edits.
